questions.q: From which country did Antigua and Barbuda gain independence in 1981?
questions.why: It is a Commonwealth realm.

questions.q: Which 2017 hurricane forced everyone to leave Barbuda?
questions.why: Almost every building was damaged.

questions.q: Who was the first Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda?
questions.why: He is called the father of the nation.

questions.q: Which British admiral was based at English Harbour in the 1780s?
questions.why: The dockyard is named after him.

questions.q: Which enslaved leader planned a 1736 uprising on Antigua?
questions.why: He is a national hero.

questions.q: Which bird colony on Barbuda is one of the largest of its kind?
questions.why: Males puff up a red throat pouch.

questions.q: Which festival in summer marks the end of slavery?
questions.why: It is held in late July and early August.

questions.q: What is Antigua's highest point, renamed in 2009?
questions.why: It was earlier called Boggy Peak.

questions.q: What is the capital of Antigua and Barbuda?
questions.why: It is on Antigua's northwest coast.

questions.q: How many beaches is Antigua said to have?
questions.a: 365, one for every day of the year
questions.why: It is a favourite tourist claim.

questions.q: Which dockyard at English Harbour is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is still a working marina.

questions.q: Which uninhabited island is the third part of the nation?
questions.why: A writer once named himself its king.

questions.q: Which lookout over English Harbour hosts Sunday parties?
questions.why: Steel bands play at sunset.

questions.q: Which beach on Barbuda is famous for its colour?
questions.why: It is about 17 miles long.

questions.q: Which sea lies west of Antigua?
questions.why: The Atlantic lies to the east.

questions.q: Which ruined fort at the end of a peninsula guards St John's harbour?
questions.why: It dates from the 1700s.

questions.q: Which lagoon on Barbuda holds the frigatebird sanctuary?
questions.why: It is next to Barbuda's only town.

questions.q: Which Antiguan cricketer is famous as 'the Master Blaster'?
questions.why: The national stadium is named after him.

questions.q: Which tall Antiguan fast bowler took 405 Test wickets?
questions.why: He is 2.01 m tall.

questions.q: Which Antiguan cricketer captained the West Indies from 1991 to 1995?
questions.why: He was known for his maroon sun hat.

questions.q: Which Antiguan writer wrote 'A Small Place'?
questions.why: She criticised tourism in it.

questions.q: Who has been Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda since 2014?
questions.why: He leads the Antigua and Barbuda Labour Party.

questions.q: Which old sugar plantation has a restored windmill and museum?
questions.why: It was one of the first big estates.

questions.q: Which caves on Barbuda hold Amerindian rock carvings?
questions.why: They are on the island's coast.

questions.q: What currency is used in Antigua and Barbuda?
questions.why: It is shared with seven other territories.

questions.q: Which crop did enslaved Africans grow on Antigua's plantations?
questions.why: Old sugar mills still dot the island.

questions.q: Which famous sailing event is held each spring?
questions.why: It began in 1967.

questions.q: Which national dish is made of cornmeal and okra?
questions.why: It is served with saltfish.

questions.q: Which sweet pineapple is grown on Antigua?
questions.why: It is the national fruit.

questions.q: Which church in St John's has twin towers?
questions.why: Its stone outside protects a wooden inside.
